austronesian-voyages#step:1.note: Yami is a descendant of PMP, not an exception. The 2230 BCE and Luzon Strait figure (infobox, cites a Bayesian-methods paper, not independently confirmed) was removed; replaced with Batanes arrival by around 2200 BCE.

austronesian-voyages#step:3.note: Source gives the range as reaching Fiji and Tonga, with Samoa the easternmost limit.

austronesian-voyages#step:4.note: Crossing is only one possibility in the source; Bantu and Arabic loanwords after c. 1000; sambo is a Bantu-origin example.

austronesian-voyages#step:6.note: Pa'ao's 1200 date attaches to a new social order, not the voyage; the 'regular voyages until 1300' claim was dropped (flagged citation needed); added 2011 radiocarbon range so step year 1250 is consistent.

austronesian-voyages#step:7.note: Hawaiki fleet is a European synthesis, now increasingly treated as myth, not oral tradition; added 2011 radiocarbon range.
